title: ynh focus ls --format json
description: Output of `ynh focus ls <harness> --format json`. Bare array of the focuses a harness declares. Envelope retrofit deferred, matching the other Phase 3 commands.

name.description: The focus's name, and the value `ynh run --focus` and `ynh agent run --focus` take.

profile.description: The profile this focus applies, when it names one. Absent means none — and a focus carrying a profile is not interchangeable with one that does not, because selecting it also selects an overlay.

prompt.description: The focus's prompt in full, not a summary. A loop driver choosing a focus needs the text it will actually send; truncating here would force every consumer to call something else to get it. The text output abbreviates instead.
